sub_category: Assam AI in School Education MoUs
question: The Assam Government signed MoUs with six organizations to integrate Artificial Intelligence in its school education system. Which of the following organizations is NOT among the six partners involved in this initiative?
rationale: The 6 partner organizations are Google AI, IIT Madras–Bodhan AI, LEHS–Wadhwani AI, Educate Girls, EkStep Foundation–AXL, and Canva Education. Microsoft India is not among them. (Page 50, 77)

sub_category: Uttarakhand CM Mukhyamantri Yuva Bhavishya Nirman Yojana
question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Mukhyamantri Yuva Bhavishya Nirman Yojana' launched in Uttarakhand:

1. It aims to provide free online coaching and study resources for competitive exams.
2. Under the first phase, exactly 25,000 students will receive free coaching.
3. The scheme covers exams like UPSC, State PSCs, SSC, NET, and GATE among others.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
rationale: Statement 2 is incorrect because the first phase of the scheme targets 11,000 students (not 25,000) for free coaching. Statements 1 and 3 are correct. (Page 50, 77)

question: The Industries Department of Bihar signed an MoU with a UAE-based foundation to set up a dedicated food processing park in Bihar. What is the name of this UAE-based foundation?
rationale: Bihar signed the MoU with the UAE-based AIM Global Foundation to develop an integrated agro-food and processing cluster. (Page 51, 77)

question: The Chhattisgarh Cabinet approved the 'CM Startup and NIPUN Mission' for youth skill development. Which of the following correctly reflects the budget outlay and the number of Emerging Technology Labs to be set up under this mission?
rationale: The mission has a financial outlay of Rs 500 crore for five years and includes setting up 100 Emerging Technology Labs focused on AI, IoT, Big Data, and Blockchain. (Page 51, 77)

question: The MoEFCC organized a national workshop on vulture conservation in Panchkula, Haryana, on the occasion of International Vulture Awareness Day (IVAD) 2026. What was the specific theme of this workshop?

options.B: From Crisis to Recovery – Conserving India’s Vultures
options.C: Vultures: The Silent Sentinels of Nature
options.D: Securing the Skies for India's Vultures
options.E: Mitigating Diclofenac: A New Era for Vultures

question:
Consider the following statements regarding World Duchenne Awareness Day (WDAD) 2026:

question:

question: The year 2026 marks the 60th anniversary of the proclamation of International Literacy Day (ILD) by UNESCO. Which specific location hosted the 2026 Global Event for ILD Celebration?
rationale: The 2026 Global Event for the UNESCO International Literacy Day Celebration was hosted in Chiapas, Mexico. (Page 94)

question: Himalaya Diwas is observed annually across India on 9 September. According to a 2026 finding by ICIMOD highlighted during the event, what percentage of glacier loss has occurred, and how has the melting rate changed since 2000?
rationale: The ICIMOD finding (2026) noted a 12% glacier loss and stated that melting has doubled since 2000. (Page 48, 95)

question: National Forest Martyrs Day is observed on 11 September to honour those who sacrificed their lives protecting forests. This specific date was chosen to commemorate the Khejarli Massacre. In which year did the Khejarli Massacre occur?
rationale: The day commemorates the Khejarli Massacre of 1730 in Khejarli, Rajasthan, where over 363 Bishnoi villagers sacrificed their lives to protect trees. (Page 49, 76)

question: Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan released the 5th revised and enlarged edition of an important work of Assamese lexicography at Gauhati University. What is the title of this book?
rationale: The VP released the 5th revised and enlarged edition of 'Chandrakanta Abhidhan', an important work of Assamese lexicography. (Page 45, 74)

question: N Purushothama Mallya, who recently passed away, received the Sahitya Akademi Translation Award in 2008 for translating which classical Tamil work into Konkani?
rationale: He advanced Konkani literature and translated 'Thirukkural' by Thiruvalluvar into Konkani in 2002, for which he received the Sahitya Akademi Translation Award in 2008. (Page 45, 74)

question: Tung Chee-hwa, who recently passed away at the age of 89, held historical significance in the political system of the People’s Republic of China. What was his notable first-time role?

options.B: First post-colonial leader of Hong Kong
options.C: First General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party from a Special Administrative Region
options.E: First Chinese Ambassador to the United Nations

rationale: Tung Chee-hwa was Hong Kong's first post-colonial leader, serving as the first Chief Executive from 1997 to 2005 after the end of British rule. (Page 44, 74)

question:
Arrange the following Formula 1 drivers in descending order based on their final finishing positions (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th) at the Italian Grand Prix 2026 at Monza:

2. Lando Norris

4. Andrea Kimi Antonelli

rationale: The final positions were: 1st - Andrea Kimi Antonelli (4), 2nd - George Russell (1), 3rd - Max Verstappen (3), and 4th - Lando Norris (2). The descending order of positions (1st to 4th) is 4, 1, 3, 2. (Page 42, 73)

question: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty became the first Indians to clinch the China Masters Men’s Doubles Title. Which Chinese pair did they defeat in the final to win the title?
rationale: They defeated China's He Jiting and Ren Xiangyu 11-21, 21-13, 21-17 in the men's doubles final. (Page 42, 73)

question: Marcos Llorente recently announced his retirement from international football. Apart from being part of the FIFA World Cup 2026 winning squad, how many total caps (appearances) did he earn representing his national team?
rationale: Marcos Llorente earned a total of 27 caps (appearances) representing the Spanish national team since his debut in 2020. (Page 43, 73)

question:
Consider the following statements regarding the newly discovered lichen species 'Buellia maharajensis':

1. It was discovered in the Mathikettan Shola National Park in Idukki district, Kerala.
2. It belongs to the family Asparagaceae.
3. It is a 'saxicolous' lichen, meaning it grows exclusively on tree bark.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
rationale: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect; it belongs to the family Caliciaceae (Asparagaceae is for Ophiopogon japonicus). Statement 3 is incorrect; 'saxicolous' means it grows on rocks, not tree bark. (Page 41, 72)

question: Researchers from the Wildlife Institute of India (WII) recorded the plant species 'Ophiopogon japonicus' for the first time in India. From which specific state and district was this discovery made?

options.E: Lahaul and Spiti district, Himachal Pradesh

rationale: The plant species 'Ophiopogon japonicus' was recorded for the first time in India from the West Kameng district, Arunachal Pradesh. (Page 42, 72)

question: Indian defence startup Apollyon Dynamics set a national record with its electric interceptor drone 'Ahuti Mk II'. Which of the following accurately reflects the top speed achieved by this UAV, establishing it as India’s fastest multirotor UAV?
rationale: Ahuti Mk II achieved a certified top speed of 498 kilometres per hour (km/h), a 66% speed increase from its previous 2025 version (300 km/h). (Page 39, 70)

question:
Consider the following statements regarding India's first advanced Ocean Research Vessel (ORV), 'Sagar Manthan':

2. The approximate cost of the vessel is Rs. 1,200 crore.

question: ISRO successfully conducted a flight acceptance hot test of the cryogenic engine CE20. Which launch vehicle stage and upcoming mission is this specific tested engine allocated for?
rationale: The CE20 engine, generating 220 kN thrust, integrates into the upgraded C32 stage of the LVM3 heavy-lift rocket and is allocated for the LVM3-M7 mission scheduled in the fourth quarter of 2026. (Page 41, 71)

question: Dr. Vinaya Prakash Singh was re-elected as the Secretary-General of the Asian-Pacific Postal Union (APPU) for a second term. His second term is scheduled to run through which of the following periods?
rationale: Dr. Vinaya Prakash Singh was re-elected for a second consecutive 4-year term, scheduled from January 2027 to December 2030. (Page 37, 69)

question: President Droupadi Murmu appointed Vinai Kumar Saxena, the Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh, to discharge additional functions as the Lt Gov of Jammu & Kashmir during the absence of Manoj Sinha. This administrative continuity is ensured under which Article of the Constitution of India?
rationale: The appointment and additional charge of the Lieutenant Governor of a Union Territory is governed by the constitutional provision of Article 239 of the Constitution of India. (Page 38, 69)

question: The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment (DoSJ&E) appointed a new Chairperson for the National Commission for Safai Karamcharis (NCSK) whose tenure will be effective until March 31, 2028. Who was appointed as the Chairperson?
rationale: Bhagwat Prasad Makwana was appointed as the Chairperson of NCSK. Kaishab Bihari was appointed as Vice-Chairperson, and the others as members. (Page 38, 69)

question: Dr. Karim Maredia was named the winner of the 2026 Borlaug CAST Communication Award. This award honors contributions to the food production and agricultural field. It was originally started in 1986 under a different name. In which year was it renamed in honor of Nobel Laureate Dr. Norman E. Borlaug?
rationale: The BCCA was started in 1986 and renamed in 2010 to honor Nobel Laureate Dr. Norman Borlaug. (Page 34, 67)

question: Union Minister Amit Shah presented the President's Colour to the Goa Police. As part of their technological advancements, the Goa Police launched a national cybercrime helpline call agent. What specific AI-based helpline number was integrated with this call agent?

question:

question: National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO) signed a technology licensing agreement with UAE's Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) to expand its aluminium smelter in Angul, Odisha. Which specific smelting technology from EGA is being licensed under this agreement?
rationale: The agreement licenses EGA’s DX+ Ultra technology to expand the aluminium smelter capacity to ~1 MTPA. (Page 32, 66)

question:
Consider the following statements regarding the non-binding MoU signed between JSW Group and Volkswagen Group:

1. The proposed joint venture structure will hold a 51:49 equity ratio.

rationale: The partnership to develop customized AI chips for AWS data centres is worth over USD 60 billion, focusing on AI inference and high-speed optical connectivity. (Page 33, 67)

question: Indian defence electronics company Samtel Avionics signed an MoU to jointly explore space debris mitigation solutions. Which foreign space technology company did they partner with, and which specific technology are they integrating?

options.A: Astroscale (Japan) integrating Active Debris Removal (ADR) harpoons
options.C: BULL Co., Ltd (Japan) integrating passive Post-Mission Disposal (PMD) tethers

options.E: Thales Alenia Space (France) integrating de-orbiting sails

rationale: Samtel Avionics signed an MoU with Japan-based BULL Co., Ltd. The collaboration integrates BULL’s proprietary passive Post-Mission Disposal (PMD) with Samtel Avionics’ Active Space Debris Removal Vehicle (DRV) technology. (Page 33, 67)

question: Axis Bank launched the 4th edition of its flagship nationwide customer engagement initiative, 'Sparsh Week 2026'. What was the central theme of this initiative?

question:

rationale: Statement 1 is incorrect because Pluxee India was authorized as a Payment Aggregator for BOTH online and physical (PA-O and PA-P) point-of-sale transactions. Statements 2 and 3 are correct. (Page 29, 65)

question: A commemorative postage stamp was released marking the 75th year of the publication of 'Dinamalar'. In which year was this Tamil daily newspaper founded?

question:

question: Project CHAYANKAN utilizes an AI-based geospatial platform for tea plantation monitoring. Which of the following technological data sources are integrated into this project's machine learning models?
